name: hub-sealed-home
goal: Prove ciphertext-only scoped storage, cached transcript before network, delta and live delivery with a verified browser enrollment, and browser latency budget

evidence: Approved design #310; compare existing Home and an enrolled browser with the same synthetic workload, verify offline first text, then delta and authenticated live output. Existing Home has no transcript action.

425450816e implements account-partitioned ciphertext and cursor transactions, local keys checked against the signed chain, cache-first Home, and authenticated delta/live reception. Device approval, browser live upgrade and attached Mac publisher require the separately owned rollout work.
